description.zh: 围绕单篇文章组织的阅读页：文章头给出标题、作者、发布时间与预计阅读时长，正文保持一行 45～75 字符的舒适行宽，侧栏或文首提供可跳转的目录，文末用作者卡与相关文章把读者留在站内。
description.en: A page for one article: header with title, author and date, a body at a comfortable measure, a table of contents, and an author card with related posts below.

use_when.zh: 展示一篇有明确标题与作者的独立长文
use_when.en: Presenting one standalone article with a title and author

use_when.zh: 正文较长，需要目录或进度提示
use_when.en: The body is long and needs a table of contents or progress cue

use_when.zh: 阅读后需要引导到相关文章或订阅
use_when.en: You want to guide readers on to related posts or subscribe

avoid_when.zh: 内容只是简短公告或卡片摘要
avoid_when.en: The content is a short note or card summary

avoid_when.zh: 多篇内容需要并列比较（用列表页更合适）
avoid_when.en: Multiple items must be compared — a list page fits better

avoid_when.zh: 文章以互动工具为主体而非文字
avoid_when.en: The post is mainly an interactive tool, not prose

note.zh: 单栏正文 + 页头元信息，最通用的阅读布局
note.en: Single-column body with header metadata, the general default

note.zh: 侧栏常驻目录，随滚动高亮当前章节
note.en: A persistent sidebar TOC that highlights the current section

note.zh: 正文按步骤编号，配代码块与提示框
note.en: Numbered steps with code blocks and callouts

note.zh: 站点导航与搜索，阅读中保持可达以便随时离开或查找。
note.en: Site nav and search, kept reachable so readers can leave or look things up.

note.zh: 标题、作者、日期、预计阅读时长与主题标签，决定是否继续读。
note.en: Title, author, date, reading time and topic tags decide whether reading continues.

note.zh: 长文必备，列出章节并可锚点跳转；窄屏折叠收起。
note.en: Essential for long posts; lists sections with anchor jumps and collapses on narrow screens.

note.zh: 保持 45～75 字符行宽与合适行高，代码、引用、图片各有样式。
note.en: Keeps a 45–75 character measure and comfortable leading; code, quotes and images get their own styles.

note.zh: 头像、简介与社交链接，为观点提供来源与信任。
note.en: Avatar, bio and social links give the piece a source and trust.

note.zh: 文末推荐三到五篇，延长会话而不是让读者立刻离开。
note.en: Three to five recommendations at the end extend the session instead of ending it.

notes.zh: 正文容器限制 max-width 为 45～75ch 并放大 line-height；目录用 position: sticky 常驻侧栏，锚点跳转前用 scroll-margin-top 预留吸顶顶栏高度。标题、代码与引用通过变量控制节奏；滚动进度可用 scroll-driven animation，并尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: Cap the body at a 45–75ch measure with generous line-height; keep the TOC sticky in a side column and reserve the sticky header height with scroll-margin-top on anchors. Pace headings, code and quotes with spacing variables; a reading-progress bar can use scroll-driven animation and must respect prefers-reduced-motion.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group — How Users Read on the Web

basic.zh: 创建一个博客文章页，包含标题元信息、正文、目录和相关文章。
basic.en: Create a blog post page with title metadata, body, a table of contents and related posts.

design.zh: 设计博客文章页：顶部细顶栏含返回与分享；文章头居中标题、作者头像与日期、阅读时长；正文单栏 65ch 行宽，标题层级清晰，代码块有底色；右侧 sticky 目录高亮当前章节；文末作者卡加三张相关文章卡。深浅色一致。
design.en: Design a blog post: a slim top bar with back and share; a centered article head with title, author avatar, date and reading time; a single 65ch body column with clear heading levels and tinted code blocks; a sticky right TOC highlighting the current section; an author card plus three related cards at the end. Theme-consistent.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现文章页：正文用 max-width 65ch、line-height 1.7；目录从标题生成锚点并用 IntersectionObserver 高亮；代码块保留横向滚动；分享按钮可复制链接；滚动进度条用 scroll-driven animation；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion；不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind article page: 65ch max-width and 1.7 line-height; build TOC anchors from headings and highlight via IntersectionObserver; allow horizontal scroll in code blocks; a share button copies the link; a scroll-driven progress bar; respect prefers-reduced-motion; no new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现博客文章页。

先检查现有排版样式、Markdown 渲染与目录组件，优先复用。
要求：
- 文章头元信息 + 正文 + 目录 + 作者卡 + 相关文章
- 正文 45～75ch 行宽，标题层级清晰
- 目录锚点可跳转并高亮当前章节
- 代码块可横向滚动，图片有 alt
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the blog post page in the current project.

Inspect existing typography styles, Markdown rendering and TOC components first; reuse them.
Requirements:
- Article head metadata + body + TOC + author card + related posts
- Body at a 45–75ch measure with clear heading levels
- TOC anchors jump and highlight the current section
- Code blocks scroll horizontally; images carry alt text
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
